name.zh: 可视化作用域编辑工作台

aliases: 大预览右侧检查器作用域提示
intent: 为需要持续视觉验证、对象发现、明确写入目标和参数密集控制的专业编辑器组合一组互补 Pattern。

patterns.purpose: 保持预览为主表面并提供有界检查器
避免高级参数形成同级参数墙
允许固定/多实例工具拥有独立写入目标
在预览中发现并定位编辑对象

composition_contract: Preview remains visual authority; discovery overlays do not become a second renderer.
Inspector regrouping does not duplicate control/domain state.
Scope explanation is derived from canonical document state plus tool binding.
Focus and pinned target are different concepts and must not silently collapse.
Narrow viewport may change presentation but not semantic ownership.

platform_realizations.web: compose from referenced Pattern realizations/reference demos
platform_realizations.android_compose: production evidence currently comes from ASS-Workbench-Android; no generic Compose reference package yet
